notes.title: Preview for Update v0.2
notes.content:
It's been awhile. But! I have been working hard on the long-awaited v0.2 Update of Super Dream-Weaver, and I'm very excited to show everyone what is coming!

#1: Updated UI and New Feature: World Maps

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649258/b8dec0286a1e6975d71e9d9d6af63da87b6c6aac.png[/img]

Key Features:
[list]
[*]Updated clock to show real time.
[*]New: UI touch hotkeys for handheld support (more on this soon!)
[*]New: Click support for PC when entering new areas and zones from the world map.
[/list]

#2: Dynamic Equipment for characters. (Bonus: Updated Battle Maps & UI)

// Green Hood & Robes (Preview)
// Shield & Dagger (Preview)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649258/488cb23863f3815a24cba41499bbeeede8efabcf.png[/img]
// Umbrella & Sabre (Preview)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649258/0bb4292320635ef91a62c2ce47ec653d93179ba3.png[/img]

#3: Updated Equipment Scene. (work in progress)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649258/0f2750bde15a4c5648e86c4953eeec4c88e25bd5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649258/ff52fb2a94b9926fb904e7d07619166634018d3c.png[/img]

Key Features:
[list]
[*]Show entire list of equipment without scrolling.
[*]Dynamic Equipment for characters: Menu, Overworld, and Battle.
[/list]

Quality of Life Updates coming:
[list]
[*]Improved Click to Move
[*]Screen FPS Controller for 60, 120, and 144 support. (Unlimited has been banished to the shadow realm)
[*]Handheld Support.
[/list]

I need to say thank you to everyone who has supported me on this journey. Stay tuned for Part 2!

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.1.50
notes.content:
Patch Notes v0.1.50

*Movement Overhaul: No more gridlock. Free range/diagonal movement.

Controller Hotfix: button sensitivity is way less sensitive.

Minor bug fixes and optimizations
Adjustments to crafting and scrap items

Misc. changes:
•Gloria now sells Wooden Shields.
•Iron Gloves now allow wielding Shields.
•Two new secret chests
•Route 1 is now three explorable areas. (down from four)
•Herbalist Satchel added to General Store.

*May require New Game.

[previewyoutube=xzlXwuo5sD8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
